newsitem.title: USA: Banyan sees Q2 workforce cuts, charges.
newsitem.headline: Banyan sees Q2 workforce cuts, charges.

text.p: Banyan Systems Inc said on Monday it expects to record pre-tax charges of between $10 million and $13 million for its second quarter, partly from a restructuring that will include a 20 percent to 25 percent workforce reduction.
About $3 million or $4 million of the charges will be cash-related, the company said. Banyan said it will consolidate facilities and production lines as part of the restructuring.
Banyan's second quarter ends June 30. The company reported a first quarter loss of $0.37 per share, compared with a profit of $0.02 per share for the same period a year ago.
The company said first quarter results were hurt by purchasing delays in several key accounts, the late delivery of several new products and "general uncertainty" from a senior-management transition.
